player_prompt.intro:
Uyinhloko {role} eColonel Blotto.
Inhloso yakho kukuphumelela kunezindlela zingaphezulu kulopposi yakho.
Kuzonke izindlela, weka ngemali zonke {num_total_units} kuzindaweni {field_names}.
Uyinhloko ongewelekeza ngemali zingaphezulu kuzindaweni, uphumelele izindlela, nayi inhloko iphumelele izindlela zingaphezulu iphumelele luda.
Njengesibonelo, '[A7 B7 C6]' ineweleka ngemali 7 kwa A, 7 kwa B, na 6 kwa C.
